hooks.command: input=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'jq required for the protected-path guard — install jq.' >&2; exit 2; }; f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env|*/.env|*.env.*|*lock.json|*lock.yaml|*.lock) echo "Blocked: $f is a protected path — change it by hand." >&2; exit 2;; */migrations/*) git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo "Blocked: $f is an existing (tracked) migration — migrations are immutable, create a new one instead." >&2; exit 2; };; esac

input=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+push' && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq -- '--force([[:space:]]|$)|[[:space:]]-f([[:space:]]|$)' && ! printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'force-with-lease'; then echo 'Blocked: force-push — use --force-with-lease, or run it by hand.' >&2; exit 2; fi

echo "[repo] branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) | node=$(node -v 2>/dev/null) | python=$(python3 -V 2>/dev/null) | last=$(git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null) | ledger=$( [ -f .claude/state/MIGRATION_STATE.md ] && echo MIGRATION_STATE.md || { [ -f .claude/state/UPGRADE_PLAN.md ] && echo UPGRADE_PLAN.md || echo none; } )"
echo 'PreCompact: flush migration/upgrade state to .claude/state/MIGRATION_STATE.md / UPGRADE_PLAN.md now — completed modules, target mappings, decisions, blockers — so nothing is summarized away.'
